company_info.description: Inforich Inc. offers mobile battery services in Japan, China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates through CHARGESPOT Domestic, CHARGESPOT Overseas, and Platform segments. The company offers ChargeSPOT, a mobile battery sharing service; CheerSPOT, a platform that connects fans with artists; and mamaro, a fully private and movable baby care room. It also provides ShareSPOT, a platform that offers sharing services, such as mobile batteries, shared bikes, umbrellas, and coworking spaces; and SPOTJOBS, a gig work platform. In addition, the company engages in digital signage, advertising, data-related, consulting and marketing services, and hardware and software development activities. Inforich Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
